observed_failure: The v2 candidate reduced false positives but increased false negatives; precision rose while recall fell below the intended floor.
locked_test_policy: The v1/v2 test IDs may be audited but never added to training, used as hard examples, or used for candidate selection.
new_data_split: Create a new provenance-checked pool grouped by subject_id + captured_date + device_id. Freeze train/validation/new-test before training.

candidate_grid.name: lora-r8-lr5e-5-positive-1.15
candidate_grid.reason: Reduce conservative drift while retaining the bounded adapter size.

candidate_grid.name: lora-r8-lr1e-4-train-hard-positive
candidate_grid.reason: Target missed subtle lesions without reading locked-test errors.

candidate_grid.name: lora-r16-lr5e-5-positive-1.15
candidate_grid.reason: Capacity check only; reject unless it clears every validation floor.

preferred_visual_upgrade.name: dedicated small-lesion detector
preferred_visual_upgrade.why: The current LoRA freezes the visual encoder and only changes language layers, so it cannot be the primary route for colour or surface-detail learning.
preferred_visual_upgrade.training_labels: ACNE04 boxes for detection; AcneSCU only after original access/license verification and true mask/category validation.

low_score_actions.blur: reject or recapture first; do not train the model to hallucinate detail
low_score_actions.lighting_or_white_balance: calibrate colour and augment training-only images with predeclared transforms
low_score_actions.small_or_occluded_lesions: detector tiling / higher resolution / training-only hard positives
low_score_actions.device_gap: collect matched captures across devices and report per-device results
low_score_actions.skin_tone_gap: balance consented data and report subgroup confidence intervals
low_score_actions.count_error: improve detector/instance segmentation rather than language-only LoRA
low_score_actions.cross_angle_inconsistency: capture guidance and geometric alignment before height claims
